H8549.def: entire (literally, figuratively or morally); also (as noun) integrity, truth

H8552.def: to complete, in a good or a bad sense, literal, or figurative, transitive or intransitive

H8564.def: an erection, i.e. pillar (probably for a guide-board)
H8564.defpt: uma ereção, ou seja, pilar (provavelmente para um guia de bordo)

H8565.def: a monster (as preternaturally formed), i.e. a sea-serpent (or other huge marine animal); also a jackal (or other hideous land animal)

H8581.kjv: (make to be) abhor(-red), (be, commit more, do) abominable(-y), [idiom] utterly.

H8582.def: to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray (literally or figuratively); also causative of both

H8586.def: caprice (as a fit coming on), i.e. vexation; concretely a tyrant

H8590.defpt: Taanak ou Tanak, um lugar na Palestina

H8610.def: to manipulate, i.e. seize; chiefly to capture, wield, specifically, to overlay; figuratively, to use unwarrantably

H8610.defpt: manipular, ou seja, apreender, principalmente para capturar, empunhar, especificamente, para sobrepor, figurativamente, para usar de forma injustificada

H8615.def: literally a cord (as an attachment); figuratively, expectancy

H8616.def: Tikvah, the name of two Israelites
H8616.defpt: Tikvah, o nome de dois israelitas

H8621.def: a Tekoite or inhabitant of Tekoah
H8621.defpt: um Tekoite ou habitante de Tekoah

H8622.def: a revolution, i.e. (of the sun) course, (of time) lapse
H8622.defpt: uma revolução, ou seja. (do sol) claro, (de tempo) lapso

H8626.def: to equalize, i.e. straighten (intransitive or transitive); figuratively, to compose
H8626.defpt: igualar, ou seja, endireitar (intransitivo ou transitivo); figurativamente, compor

H8631.def: to become (causatively, make) mighty or (figuratively) obstinate

H8636.def: multiplication, i.e. percentage or bonus in addition to principal

H8641.def: a present (as offered up), especially in sacrifice or as tribute
H8641.defpt: um presente (como oferecido), especialmente em sacrifício ou como tributo

H8643.def: clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry; especially clangorof trumpets, as an alarum

H8646.defpt: Terach, o pai de Abraão, também um lugar no deserto

H8650.def: a pole (as a mast or flagstaff)

H8651.def: a door; by implication, a palace
H8651.defpt: uma porta, por implicação, um palácio

H8654.defpt: um tiratite ou habitante de um Tirah desconhecido

H8655.def: Teraphim (singular or plural) a family idol
H8655.defpt: Teraphim (singular ou plural) um ídolo de família

H8656.def: Tirtsah, a place in Palestine; also an Israelitess
H8656.defpt: Tirtsah, um lugar na Palestina, também um Israelita

H8660.defpt: Tirshatha, o título de um deputado ou governador persa

H8664.def: a Tishbite or inhabitant of Tishbeh (in Gilead)
H8664.defpt: um Tishbite ou habitante de Tishbeh (em Gileade)

H8666.def: a recurrence (of time or place); a reply (as returned)
H8666.defpt: uma repetição (de hora ou lugar); uma resposta (como retornado)

H8668.def: rescue (literal or figurative, persons, national or spiritual)
H8668.defpt: resgate (literal ou figurativo, pessoas, nacional ou espiritual)
